object.name: evi.freqshift.hilbert~
object.digest: Time-domain Hilbert frequency shifter effect with three simultaneous sidebands outputs
object.description: Like MSP <o>freqshift~</o> but with a different hilbert filter and additional features, such as anti-aliased saturation.

inlets.digest: If float/int, Frequency Shift in Hz +/- 0., use @freqsmooth to smooth / If signal + FM modulation of Freq Shift ± Hz
inlets.description: float/int/signal. If float/int, frequency shift in Hz +/- 0. (use 'freqsmooth' attribute to smooth). If signal, + audio rate FM of freq shift amount ± Hz.

outlets.description: Sidebands mixed and optionally saturated (use 'bandsmix' attribute and 'drive' attribute).

outlets.digest: 3 Channels: Quad Osc Cos / Quad Osc Sin / Sync 0..1
outlets.description: Three utility audio channels on a single 3-channel multichannel signal cable. Quad Osc Cos / Quad Osc Sin / Sync 0..1. These can be useful for synchronising downstream processing.

messages.name: coeffs
messages.digest: In left inlet, coeffs message to evi.freqshift.hilbert~
messages.description: Sending the symbol 'coeffs' to the abstraction displays the current coefficients of the internal Polyphase IIR Hilbert Allpass Cascade filters in a dictionary window. This has no effect on the abstraction and is pointless other than if someone is interested.

messages.name: resetphase
messages.digest: In left inlet, resetphase message to evi.freqshift.hilbert~
messages.description: Sending the symbol 'resetphase' to the abstraction has the same effect as sending 'resetphase' to the MSP 'freqshift~' object - it resets the phase of the quadrature oscillators that modulate the sidebands of the incoming signal. Note that in 'evi.freqshift.hilbert~' this message need not be used, as a major feature of the internal gen~ code is that it does automatic and clickless resetting of phase itself (depending on the 'resetauto' attribute, which is on by default).

attributes.name: bandsmix
attributes.description: Mix the far left outlet between 0 = Upper (or positive) and 1 = Lower (or negative) SideBands. Smoothed by the 'smooth' attribute.

attributes.name: drive
attributes.description: If the 'saturation' attribute is set to on (1), 'drive' adds gain shaping to the internal sine shaping saturation algorithm. This affects the far left bands mixing outlet but not the separately avilable USB and LSB outlets.

attributes.name: freqsmooth
attributes.description: Smoothing amount in ms for the frequency shifting float/int 2nd inlet (not to the signal input to the 2nd inlet). Because float/int and signal are separated, and FM signal rate control to the 2nd inlet is merged with the smoothed freq shift float/int amount after this smoothing factor, the smoothing need not be turned off (0) when using audio rate FM if not wished for.

attributes.name: resetauto
attributes.description: If set to on (1, default), phase resetting of the internal quadrature oscillators happens automatically and clicklessly. If set to off (0), 'evi.freqshift.hilbert~' behaves like MSP 'freqshift~' and requires resetting the phase with a message ('resetphase') which clicks.

attributes.name: saturation
attributes.description: Turn the internal saturation off (0) or on (1). This saturation is a sine shaping waveshaper that is controlled by the 'drive' attribute. It is only applied to the far left bands mix outlet.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smooth time in ms of the internal parameters. Note that the freq shift inlet has it's own independent smoothing attribute ('freqsmooth').
